class.name: ImageSaveOptions
class.brief_description: Encoder options for saving an [ImageTexture] or an [Image] to an image file with [method ResourceSaver.save].

method.name: attach_to
method.description: Attaches these options to [param resource] (an [ImageTexture] or an [Image]). [method ResourceSaver.save] uses them whenever it writes [param resource] to an image file. Later changes to these options apply to the next save. Replaces options attached before.

method.name: detach_from
method.description: Removes the options attached to [param resource], if any. Its next save uses the default options.

method.name: get_attached
method.description: Returns the options attached to [param resource] with [method attach_to], or [code]null[/code] if there are none.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], single-channel images ([constant Image.FORMAT_R8], [constant Image.FORMAT_RH], [constant Image.FORMAT_RF]) are written to OpenEXR files as a grayscale channel instead of a red channel. Ignored for images with more than one channel. See [method Image.save_exr].
Quality of JPEG files, between [code]0.0[/code] (smallest file) and [code]1.0[/code] (best quality). See [method Image.save_jpg].
If [code]true[/code], WebP files are compressed lossy with [member webp_quality]. If [code]false[/code], they are lossless.
Quality of lossy WebP files, between [code]0.0[/code] (smallest file) and [code]1.0[/code] (best quality). Ignored for lossless WebP. See [method Image.save_webp].
